breakdown.description: The inward hole pressure is reversed to an outward traction by changing the sign relative to the solid normal
breakdown.reason: The known issue was an incorrect sign convention that made hole pressure outward (t = +p*n). The generated specification states the pressure is 'directed towards the center of the hole,' which corresponds to inward loading and is consistent with the ground truth convention (t = -p*n with outward solid normal). Thus the sign/direction inconsistency is fixed.
